## What This Is

The two PDFs shipped in v2.6.0 carried incorrect `/Title` metadata. The visible content was correct. The PDF properties dialog showed the wrong title. Fixed in this release. Re-download if you previously saved local copies and want the metadata to render correctly.

## What It Adds / Changes

- `/Title` metadata corrected on `Getting Started/Quick Start Guide.pdf`
- `/Title` metadata corrected on `Getting Started/Build Sequence.pdf`

No content changes. No structural changes. Cosmetic metadata fix only.

## How to Implement

If you previously downloaded the v2.6.0 PDFs and want clean metadata, replace your local copies with the v2.7.2 files. Otherwise no action required.

## Prerequisites

None.

## Optional?

Yes. Skip if PDF metadata does not affect your workflow.
